QuestInfo.name: A Rose in Trade
QuestInfo.0: Even after hearing her sad story, you decided you couldn't let Mont Blanc go. You leave her to her fate with the Cygnus Knights, and that is the last you hear of her... until a letter from Neinheart arrives.
